name: engbrain-retrieval-holdout-v1
notice: Freshly written retrieval phrasings over the existing 5 simplified public-issue and 7 synthetic incident fixtures. The target incidents are not independent from the Codex fixture corpus; use this as a frozen retrieval challenge, not as evidence from full upstream repositories.

targets.title: Empty CURL_CA_BUNDLE must retain certificate verification
targets.problem: A Requests issue showed that CURL_CA_BUNDLE set to the empty string disabled certificate verification. The intended behavior is the same as an unset value: use the default system trust bundle. A non-empty value still selects the configured CA path.

queries.lexical: Empty CURL_CA_BUNDLE must retain certificate verification A Requests issue showed that CURL_CA_BUNDLE set to the empty string disabled certificate verification. The intended behavior is the same as an unset value: use the default system trust bundle. A non-empty value still selects the configured CA path.
queries.paraphrase: An empty trust-bundle override accidentally turns off TLS certificate checking.
queries.symptom: HTTPS requests stop validating peers when a deployment variable is set to nothing.

targets.title: Keep urllib3 install and runtime bounds consistent
targets.problem: Requests allowed urllib3 1.23 in installation metadata while its runtime check still rejected versions above 1.22.

queries.lexical: Keep urllib3 install and runtime bounds consistent Requests allowed urllib3 1.23 in installation metadata while its runtime check still rejected versions above 1.22.
queries.paraphrase: Installing a dependency release succeeds, but importing the package rejects that same release.
queries.symptom: A clean install passes dependency resolution and then emits an incompatibility warning at import time.

targets.title: Preserve assertion diffs in importlib package tests
targets.problem: A pytest regression omitted the assertion explanation when importlib mode loaded a test from a package containing __init__.py.

queries.lexical: Preserve assertion diffs in importlib package tests A pytest regression omitted the assertion explanation when importlib mode loaded a test from a package containing __init__.py.
queries.paraphrase: Package tests loaded through the alternate importer show a bare assertion without expected and actual values.
queries.symptom: CI failure output omits the useful diff only for tests inside packages under the alternate load mode.

targets.title: Resolve Click version from the installed distribution
targets.problem: Click's implicit version lookup can infer a callback module name such as cli even when the installed distribution has a different name, so --version fails with PackageNotFoundError.

queries.lexical: Resolve Click version from the installed distribution Click's implicit version lookup can infer a callback module name such as cli even when the installed distribution has a different name, so --version fails with PackageNotFoundError.
queries.paraphrase: The generated version switch looks up metadata under the import module's name and crashes when distribution naming differs.
queries.symptom: Running --version raises a missing-package-metadata error even though the application is installed.

targets.title: Mark Click group commands optional when invocation can omit them
targets.problem: A Click group configured with invoke_without_command=True rendered COMMAND as required in its usage synopsis instead of [COMMAND].

queries.lexical: Mark Click group commands optional when invocation can omit them A Click group configured with invoke_without_command=True rendered COMMAND as required in its usage synopsis instead of [COMMAND].
queries.paraphrase: A command group that can run empty still prints a mandatory child-command placeholder.
queries.symptom: The usage line wraps COMMAND in no brackets despite a callback that should run without a subcommand.

targets.title: Allow four concurrent pool workers
targets.problem: The pool configuration permits one connection while the service runs four concurrent workers.

queries.lexical: Allow four concurrent pool workers The pool configuration permits one connection while the service runs four concurrent workers.
queries.paraphrase: Parallel workers queue forever because the configured connection slots are fewer than active workers.
queries.symptom: Load checks hang at four simultaneous jobs while the service has only one DB slot.

targets.title: Do not return not-modified for deleted files
targets.problem: A cached modification timestamp can cause a deleted resource to be treated as unchanged.

queries.lexical: Do not return not-modified for deleted files A cached modification timestamp can cause a deleted resource to be treated as unchanged.
queries.paraphrase: A removed resource still receives a not-modified response because its saved timestamp remains in cache.
queries.symptom: A deleted file is reported as unchanged to a client that supplied a cached validator.

targets.title: Preserve explicitly empty process environment values
targets.problem: An explicitly empty process environment value is replaced by a non-empty dotenv fallback.

queries.lexical: Preserve explicitly empty process environment values An explicitly empty process environment value is replaced by a non-empty dotenv fallback.
queries.paraphrase: A blank shell setting is treated as absent, so a dotenv file silently overrides the operator's choice.
queries.symptom: Setting a variable to an empty string does not survive configuration loading.

targets.title: Return a successful status for CORS preflight
targets.problem: An OPTIONS preflight inherits a later request's 404 or 503 status and is rejected by the browser.

queries.lexical: Return a successful status for CORS preflight An OPTIONS preflight inherits a later request's 404 or 503 status and is rejected by the browser.
queries.paraphrase: The browser's OPTIONS negotiation inherits an error code from the later resource request.
queries.symptom: A cross-origin browser request is blocked because its preliminary request returns the resource's failure status.

targets.title: Acknowledge queue work only after persistence
targets.problem: A queue item is acknowledged before the durable write succeeds, losing work on persistence errors.

queries.lexical: Acknowledge queue work only after persistence A queue item is acknowledged before the durable write succeeds, losing work on persistence errors.
queries.paraphrase: A broker discards work after the consumer confirms delivery but before the durable write completes.
queries.symptom: Messages disappear when persistence raises between delivery and acknowledgment.

targets.title: Normalize naive and aware timestamps to UTC
targets.problem: Timestamp serialization preserves a local offset instead of producing a stable UTC representation.

queries.lexical: Normalize naive and aware timestamps to UTC Timestamp serialization preserves a local offset instead of producing a stable UTC representation.
queries.paraphrase: Serializing a timestamp keeps its local offset or leaves a timezone-free value ambiguous.
queries.symptom: Equivalent instants produce different strings depending on whether the input carried an offset.

targets.title: Set a bounded SQLite busy timeout
targets.problem: The connection options use a zero-second lock wait, so brief concurrent writes fail immediately.

queries.lexical: Set a bounded SQLite busy timeout The connection options use a zero-second lock wait, so brief concurrent writes fail immediately.
queries.paraphrase: A brief database lock immediately fails writes instead of allowing a bounded wait.
queries.symptom: Concurrent writers fail immediately during a short-lived lock burst.

distractors.title: Database connection retry backoff
distractors.problem: A short jittered backoff prevents a burst of retries when PostgreSQL returns a transient network error.

distractors.title: Pool idle connections after deploy
distractors.problem: Reducing idle lifetime removes server-side connections left behind by old application workers.

distractors.title: Database socket file permission
distractors.problem: The local service account could not open the database socket because its directory permissions were too restrictive.

distractors.title: Rotate the database password
distractors.problem: The deployment secret changed but the connection string in the worker environment was not refreshed.

distractors.title: CA bundle missing in slim image
distractors.problem: The minimal container image omitted the operating system CA certificates needed for outbound HTTPS.

distractors.title: Certificate expires in staging
distractors.problem: The staging server served an expired leaf certificate and failed the browser trust check.

distractors.title: TLS minimum version mismatch
distractors.problem: The old test appliance only negotiated TLS 1.0 while the client required TLS 1.2.

distractors.title: Compose service DNS alias
distractors.problem: A container used localhost instead of the Compose service name when connecting to Redis.

distractors.title: Docker image copied wrong config
distractors.problem: The Docker build copied the development settings file over the production configuration.

distractors.title: Container port was not published
distractors.problem: The application listened on port 8080 inside Docker, but the host port mapping was missing.

distractors.title: SQLite read transaction lasted too long
distractors.problem: A cursor remained open while rendering a report, delaying a writer in another thread.

distractors.title: SQLite journal mode on network drive
distractors.problem: WAL mode behaved poorly on a shared network filesystem and was replaced with a local volume.

distractors.title: Unique index migration locked table
distractors.problem: Building a new unique index took long enough to block writes during deployment.

distractors.title: Async task leaked after request
distractors.problem: A background coroutine was never awaited and logged an exception after the response completed.

distractors.title: Async timeout cancelled child request
distractors.problem: The parent timeout cancelled a child task that was expected to finish its cleanup handler.

distractors.title: Thread pool saturated by file reads
distractors.problem: Large synchronous file reads filled the worker pool and delayed lightweight API handlers.

distractors.title: Pytest fixture scope mismatch
distractors.problem: A module-scoped fixture depended on a function-scoped database fixture and failed setup.

distractors.title: Pytest did not collect integration tests
distractors.problem: The test filename did not match the configured collection pattern, so CI skipped the suite.

distractors.title: Import collision with local module
distractors.problem: A project file named json.py shadowed the Python standard library during test startup.

distractors.title: PowerShell path contains spaces
distractors.problem: A script split a Windows executable path at spaces because the path was not passed as one argument.

distractors.title: Shell script used CRLF line endings
distractors.problem: Git Bash reported a bad interpreter because the script had Windows line endings.

distractors.title: Environment variable name typo
distractors.problem: The worker looked up CACHE_URL while the deployment manifest set REDIS_URL.

distractors.title: CORS origin missing scheme
distractors.problem: The allowlist used a hostname without the https scheme and did not match the browser origin.

distractors.title: CORS credentials wildcard rejected
distractors.problem: The browser refused credentialed requests because the server returned a wildcard origin.

distractors.title: Queue visibility timeout too short
distractors.problem: A long-running job was delivered twice after its visibility timeout expired.

distractors.title: Queue poison message retry loop
distractors.problem: A malformed message exhausted worker capacity because it was retried without a dead-letter policy.

distractors.title: Consumer committed offset too early
distractors.problem: The stream offset advanced before the batch finished, skipping rows after a process crash.

distractors.title: UTC display used wrong locale
distractors.problem: A report rendered UTC timestamps without converting them to the user's selected locale.

distractors.title: Daylight saving time duplicated hour
distractors.problem: A local-time aggregation counted the repeated clock hour twice during the autumn transition.

distractors.title: Cache key omitted tenant identifier
distractors.problem: Two customers shared a cache entry because the tenant ID was not included in the key.
